description: One tilt measurement of the can, produced by the vision agent.

can_found.description: false means the whole measurement is unavailable; angles are ignored.
can_found.title: Can Found

forward_deg.description: + = top leans away from the user, - = toward the user. null = unavailable.
forward_deg.title: Forward Deg

right_deg.description: + = top leans right, - = leans left. null = unavailable.
right_deg.title: Right Deg

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this contract. Optional on the wire; defaults to the current version.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

timestamp_ms.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the measurement was taken.
timestamp_ms.title: Timestamp Ms

title: TiltUpdate
